svg.title: TRAVERSE: the biggest testosterone trial, what went up and what did not
svg.desc: Share of men with each event, testosterone gel vs placebo gel, in the TRAVERSE trial of 5,246 men aged 45 to 80. Heart attack, stroke or heart death 7.0% vs 7.3%. Heart-rhythm problems needing treatment 5.2% vs 3.3%. Atrial fibrillation 3.5% vs 2.4%. Bone fracture 3.5% vs 2.5%. Acute kidney injury 2.3% vs 1.5%. Pulmonary embolism 0.9% vs 0.5%.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Testosterone passed the heart test. Other problems went up.
